description: The connected account and the key it acts as: environment, scopes, company name and whether one is still required (GET /v1/me), plus the UK credits left (GET /v1/usage), the Australian washes left (GET /v1/dncr) and the dead number checks left (GET /v1/dead-number). A balance the key lacks the scope for comes back as that error. Costs nothing.
name: get_account
title: Account and balances
